systemAudioOn: System audio: on (meeting sound, not the screen)
systemAudioOff: System audio: off — mic only. Other people may be missing, especially with headphones.
permissionHint: macOS will ask for Microphone and Screen Recording. While developing, the app may appear as Electron (or Pith Capture Helper). Screen Recording is only used to hear other apps (Zoom, Meet, Teams), not to save video or screenshots.
grantAgain: If you just allowed Screen Recording, click Start again.
noSpeech: No speech detected in the mix. Speak while listening, or play something (YouTube / a call). Also enable Microphone for Pith Capture Helper in System Settings → Privacy.
errorHelperMissing: Capture helper is missing. From frontend/, run npm start (it builds the native helper).
errorHelperExit: Capture stopped before the mix was sent. Start a new note and try Generate again.
errorMacosOnly: Capture is macOS only in this MVP.
errorNoKey: CAPTURE_SPIKE_KEY is missing in frontend/.env (same value as backend/.env).
errorEmpty: No audio was captured. Try Start, speak, then Stop.
errorTooShort: The amount of audio recorded is not enough. Keep listening for at least {seconds} seconds, then Generate.
errorNotListening: Capture was not recording. Start a new note, then Generate.
errorFileTooLarge: That recording is too large to upload at once. Restart the API (long mixes are now split) and try again.
errorNoLastMix: There is no mix to resend. Record again, then Stop. Restarting the app discards the last mix.
errorConfig: Could not load listen settings. Start the API and wait a moment.
errorMicLost: The microphone was disconnected. Plug it in or choose another input in Sound settings.
homeLead: Workspaces hold your notes. New note starts a mock listen — capture still runs from Capture spike until Step 12b.
emptyNotes: No notes in this workspace yet.
mockBanner: Mock notepad. Workspaces and notes are fake. Sign-in, plan, and remaining time are real when you are signed in.
errorWorkspaceNotEmpty: Delete the notes in this workspace first. A workspace must be empty before you can delete it.
errorNoteProcessing: Wait until processing finishes, or cancel the listen.
errorOneListen: Finish or cancel the current listen first.
listeningMockHint: Mock listen. Pause freezes the clock; Resume continues; Stop shows sample bullets. This does not record audio.
mockBullet1: Keep the decisions. Drop the recording.
